text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: White ribbed sheer sleeveless high-neck crop top over white opaque bralette, matching sheer white asymmetrical skirt panel layered over black flared trousers, black pointed shoes. Show empty garments with no skin.. Add ONLY these accessories: black narrow leather belt; black crescent leather shoulder bag; narrow black sunglasses; silver wide cuff bracelet; pair of silver hoop earrings. Closed inventory: use each listed item exactly once and add no other objects.
original_prompt: Create one photorealistic COMPLETE hollow wardrobe outfit on pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped with margins. Image 1 is the exact empty clothing ensemble; preserve its garments, shoes, materials and proportions. Image 2 is the original styling reference; use ONLY 上排左. Add ONLY this closed accessory inventory, each once: black narrow leather belt; black crescent leather shoulder bag; narrow black sunglasses; silver wide cuff bracelet; pair of silver hoop earrings. Style these listed accessories as in the reference using invisible supports; bag beside ensemble. No human, hair, skin, body parts, mannequin or stands. No additional belts, scarves, ties, bags, jewelry, props or clothing. No text, watermark or collage.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
